rationale.ja: Variables見出しのみ。入出力portとrun前map／adapter設定の義務は下位に保持する。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; constructor, pre_predict and pending-transaction checking remain separately specified.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。constructor、pre_predict、待機transaction検査は個別の規定に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; the constructor and protected helpers plus read/write hooks retain their subordinate contracts and unresolved conditions.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。constructor、protected helper、read／write hookは下位契約と未解決条件を保持する。

rationale.en: The overview introduces abstract and physical operation descriptors and their role at adapter boundaries. Related item and conversion requirements decompose selected observable contracts; bus-width/endianness conditions in 19.1.2 remain separately open.
rationale.ja: 概要は抽象／物理operation descriptorとadapter境界での役割を導入する。関連item／変換要求は選択した観測可能契約を分解し、19.1.2のbus幅／endianness条件は別に未完とする。

rationale.en: The overview describes a bus-independent transaction and a map handle for optional custom translation. The related descriptor/map obligations cover those selected properties without requiring a new custom-translation algorithm or asserting every content field.
rationale.ja: 概要はbus-independent transactionと任意のcustom変換用map handleを説明する。関連descriptor／map義務は選択した性質を扱い、新たなcustom変換algorithmや全内容fieldを要求しない。

rationale.en: The overview names conversion between generic register operations and bus accesses. Selected conversion obligations are decomposed under the adapter methods rather than duplicated as an additional stream algorithm.
rationale.ja: 概要はgeneric register operationとbus accessの変換を示す。選択した変換義務はadapter methodへ分解し、追加のstream algorithmとして重複計数しない。

rationale.en: The overview introduces the generic-to-bus conversion interface; concrete declaration and selected reg2bus/bus2reg contracts are decomposed by related requirements. It does not resolve the separate parent_sequence do_clone wording.
rationale.ja: 概要はgeneric-to-bus変換interfaceを導入する。具象宣言と選択したreg2bus／bus2reg契約は関連要求へ分解する。別のparent_sequenceのdo_clone文言は解決しない。

rationale.en: The overview identifies the generic-payload adapter interface. Its inheritance and selected conversions are decomposed by the related requirements; absolute one-way byte/lane interpretation remains open.
rationale.ja: 概要はgeneric-payload adapter interfaceを示す。継承と選択した変換は関連要求へ分解し、片方向の絶対byte／lane解釈は未完に残す。

rationale.en: The overview describes bus-observation-based prediction subject to access policy, excluding memories. The related mirror/publication and nonregister-ignore requirements decompose these obligations; this is not a second all-policy conformance claim.
rationale.ja: 概要はaccess policyに従うbus観測による予測とmemoryの除外を説明する。関連mirror／公開とnonregister無視の要求へ義務を分解し、全policy適合を重ねて主張しない。

rationale.en: The overview permits custom backdoors when default pure-SystemVerilog/DPI access is unsuitable. Related original-storage extensions exercise this customization route without requiring a physical HDL target or interpreting the native HDL API contracts.
rationale.ja: 概要は既定のpure-SystemVerilog／DPI accessが適さない場合のcustom backdoorを認める。関連する独自記憶域の拡張でこのcustom経路を検査し、物理HDL対象の必須化やnative HDL API契約の解釈はしない。

rationale.en: Variables heading only; model, adapter and upstream sequencer roles remain in their subordinate clauses.
rationale.ja: Variables見出しのみ。model、adapter、upstream sequencerの役割は下位条項に残る。

rationale.en: Common-methods heading only; constructor, repeated body and direct-item execution have separate subordinate contracts.
rationale.ja: Common methods見出しのみ。constructor、反復body、直接item実行は下位の個別契約にある。

rationale.en: Variables heading only; rw_info and sequencer retain their own subordinate obligations.
rationale.ja: Variables見出しのみ。rw_infoとsequencerは下位の個別義務を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; the HDL support routines retain separate success/failure and force/release contracts.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。HDL support routineは成功／失敗、force／releaseの個別契約を保持する。

rationale.en: The overview introduces the register stimulus base classes. Related test, translation and frontdoor requirements decompose selected roles without adding an independent stimulus-generation algorithm.
rationale.ja: 概要はregister stimulus基底classを導入する。関連test／translation／frontdoor要求は選択した役割を分解し、独立したstimulus生成algorithmを追加しない。

rationale.en: The overview distinguishes user test and layered translation roles and permits register access outside this base class. Related requirements decompose selected convenience/model use and actual translation. Optional use is not a new requirement to derive every register stimulus from this class.
rationale.ja: 概要はuser testとlayered translationの役割を区別し、この基底外からのregister accessも認める。関連要求は選択した便利API／model利用と実translationを分解する。任意利用を、全register stimulusがこのclassから派生すべき新しい義務とはしない。

rationale.en: The overview describes the common convenience delegation and implicit parent convention; the ten child APIs and related context requirements retain those obligations and their separate defaults. No additional unnamed convenience method or separate algorithm is introduced.
rationale.ja: 概要は共通の便利委譲と暗黙parent規約を説明し、10の子APIと関連context要求が、その義務と別々の既定値を保持する。名前のない追加便利methodや別algorithmは導入しない。

rationale.en: The overview introduces custom physical-access facade sequences, including nonlinear or unmapped mechanisms. Related inheritance and original custom-frontdoor access requirements cover selected observable roles; physical DUT implementations and arbitrary nonlinear protocols remain separate.
rationale.ja: 概要は非線形／unmapped機構を含むcustom物理access facade sequenceを導入する。関連継承と独自custom-frontdoor access要求が選択した観測可能な役割を扱い、物理DUT実装と任意非線形protocolは別に残す。

rationale.en: The overview introduces the HDL backdoor implementation interface and the compile-time opt-out. Related parameter and actual check/deposit/read requirements decompose selected contracts. The no-DPI parameter probes do not certify HDL execution, and untested force/release clauses remain open.
rationale.ja: 概要はHDL backdoor実装interfaceとcompile時の無効化を導入する。関連parameterと実際のcheck／deposit／read要求が選択した契約を分解する。no-DPI parameter probeはHDL実行を認定せず、未検査のforce／release条項は未完に残す。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; event-base construction, waits and state/count queries retain their own subordinate contracts.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。event-base生成、待機、状態／件数照会は下位の個別契約を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; typed-event construction, trigger and data APIs remain separately specified.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。型付きeventの生成、trigger、data APIは個別規定に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; callback construction and pre/post-trigger contracts remain in child clauses.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。callback生成とpre／post-trigger契約は子条項に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; barrier construction, threshold, wait, reset and count contracts remain separate.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。barrier生成、threshold、wait、reset、count契約は個別に残る。

rationale.en: Pool-classes heading only, followed directly by the individual pool clauses; it adds no independent operation.
rationale.ja: Pool classes見出しのみで個別pool条項が直後に続き、独立の操作を追加しない。

rationale.en: Common-methods heading only; event-pool methods retain their own contracts and unresolved get_global declaration/prose issue.
rationale.ja: Common methods見出しのみ。event-pool methodは個別契約とget_global宣言／本文の未解決点を保持する。

rationale.en: Common-methods heading only; barrier-pool methods retain their own contracts and unresolved get_global declaration/prose issue.
rationale.ja: Common methods見出しのみ。barrier-pool methodは個別契約とget_global宣言／本文の未解決点を保持する。

rationale.en: The overview introduces event, barrier, named-pool and callback services. Related state/wait, threshold, singleton and callback requirements decompose selected roles without adding another scheduling algorithm. It does not close untested conditions.
rationale.ja: 概要はevent、barrier、名前付きpool、callback serviceを導入する。関連する状態／wait、threshold、singleton、callback要求が選択した役割を分解し、別のschedule algorithmを追加しない。未検査条件は解消しない。

rationale.en: The overview names the event base and typed derivative; selected inheritance and typed data obligations are decomposed in related declarations and getter requirements.
rationale.ja: 概要はevent基底と型付き派生型を示し、選択した継承と型付きdata義務を関連宣言／getter要求へ分解する。

rationale.en: The overview describes an abstract event wrapper with callbacks and waiter accounting. Related callback and actual-count requirements decompose selected services; this does not certify every event scheduling condition.
rationale.ja: 概要はcallbackとwaiter計数を持つ抽象event wrapperを説明する。関連callback／実件数要求が選択serviceを分解し、全event schedule条件を認定しない。

rationale.en: The overview describes the typed derivative and optional trigger-data type. Related declared type, scalar-value and object-handle requirements cover selected conditions without duplicating a new data transport algorithm.
rationale.ja: 概要は型付き派生型と省略可能なtrigger-data型を説明する。関連する宣言型、scalar値、object handle要求が選択条件を扱い、新たなdata転送algorithmを重複させない。

rationale.en: The overview introduces derived callbacks attached to events as an alternative to waiter processes. Related declaration and pre/post-trigger requirements decompose selected observable contracts; disabled callback behavior remains a separate known difference.
rationale.ja: 概要はwaiter processに代わる、eventへ付ける派生callbackを導入する。関連宣言とpre／post-trigger要求が選択した観測可能契約を分解し、無効callback動作は別の既知差分に残る。

rationale.en: The overview describes threshold-based multi-process blocking and release. Related wait, changed-threshold and reset requirements decompose selected obligations rather than creating a second synchronization algorithm.
rationale.ja: 概要はthresholdに基づく複数processの待機と解放を説明する。関連wait、threshold変更、reset要求が選択義務を分解し、別の同期algorithmを作らない。

rationale.en: The overview identifies a collection of barriers; exact generic inheritance and existing keyed-creation requirements decompose the selected role, without implying a separate initial-membership rule or resolving get_global return type.
rationale.ja: 概要はbarrierの集合を示し、正確なgeneric継承と既存key生成要求が選択役割を分解する。別の初期所属規則やget_global戻り型の解決は含意しない。

rationale.en: Objection-control heading only; propagation mode, raise/drop, clear and drain retain subordinate contracts.
rationale.ja: Objection control見出しのみ。propagation mode、raise／drop、clear、drainは下位契約に残る。

rationale.en: Callback-hooks heading only; raised, dropped and all_dropped remain separate functions/tasks.
rationale.ja: Callback hooks見出しのみ。raised、dropped、all_droppedは個別function／taskに残る。

rationale.en: Objection-status heading only; list, event wait and source/total queries remain separately specified.
rationale.ja: Objection status見出しのみ。一覧、event待ち、source／total照会は個別規定に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; the three registered objection callback contracts remain in the child clauses.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。3つの登録objection callback契約は子条項に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; callback construction, mode and enabled query retain separate contracts and the omitted-mode default ambiguity.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。callback生成、mode、enable照会は個別契約とmode省略値の曖昧さを保持する。

rationale.en: Common-parameters heading only; object and callback type requirements remain in the two child clauses.
rationale.ja: Common parameters見出しのみ。object／callback型要求は2つの子条項に残る。

rationale.en: Add/delete-interface heading only; registration and name-based addition/removal retain their individual obligations.
rationale.ja: Add／delete interface見出しのみ。登録と名前による追加／削除は個別義務を保持する。

rationale.en: The introduction names the objection mechanism. Related count, propagation and callback requirements decompose selected contracts without adding a distinct coordination algorithm.
rationale.ja: 導入はobjection機構を示す。関連count、propagation、callback要求は選択契約を分解し、別の協調algorithmを追加しない。

rationale.en: The overview identifies status coordination among components, objects and module-based participants. Related source/total and event-wait requirements cover selected roles; arbitrary participant combinations remain open.
rationale.ja: 概要はcomponent、object、module-based参加者の状態協調を示す。関連source／totalとevent待ち要求が選択役割を扱い、任意の参加者組合せは未完に残す。

rationale.en: The overview and note identify the registered objection callback type and specific-objection registration alias. Related inheritance and actual raised/drop/all-drop requirements decompose selected roles without an additional callback algorithm.
rationale.ja: 概要と注記は登録objection callback型と特定objection用登録aliasを示す。関連継承と実際のraised／drop／all-drop要求へ選択役割を分解し、追加callback algorithmはない。

rationale.en: The introduction groups callback registration, management and user extension classes. Related declarations and actual registration requirements retain their separate contracts.
rationale.ja: 導入はcallback登録、管理、user拡張classをまとめ、関連宣言と実登録要求が個別契約を保持する。

rationale.en: The overview introduces the user callback base and optional virtual user hooks. Related base/type and original typed-dispatch requirements cover selected roles without requiring a specific new user hook signature.
rationale.ja: 概要はuser callback基底と任意のvirtual user hookを導入する。関連基底／型と独自の型付き委譲要求が選択役割を扱い、特定の新user hook signatureは要求しない。

rationale.en: The overview describes typed customizable hooks and valid object/callback pair registration. Related type and valid-pair dispatch requirements decompose selected roles; invalid-pair rejection and diagnostic details are not certified.
rationale.ja: 概要は型付きcustom hookと有効なobject／callback組の登録を説明する。関連型と有効組の委譲要求が選択役割を分解し、不正組の拒否や診断詳細は認定しない。

rationale.en: The overview introduces static iterators and recommends the optional facade. Individual endpoint/next/previous obligations are decomposed by existing requirements; the recommendation adds no separate executable iterator operation.
rationale.ja: 概要はstatic iteratorと任意facadeの推奨を導入する。endpoint／next／previousの個別義務は既存要求へ分解し、推奨は別の実行iterator操作を追加しない。
